scenes.text: One galaxy spins far too fast for everything we can see inside it.
scenes.art_prompt: the galaxy that holds itself - scene 1, cinematic, 3d

scenes.text: By the math, its stars should have drifted apart billions of years ago.
scenes.art_prompt: the galaxy that holds itself - scene 2, cinematic, 3d

scenes.text: Something invisible is holding it together. We call it dark matter.
scenes.art_prompt: the galaxy that holds itself - scene 3, cinematic, 3d

scenes.text: We have never seen it. We have only ever measured its shadow.
scenes.art_prompt: the galaxy that holds itself - scene 4, cinematic, 3d

scenes.text:
We named the missing weight long before we understood the scale.
Most of the universe is the part that never answers.
